=== Here are the list of commands you can do on the DonutSMP: ===
/home - allows you to set a home which you can teleport to you will have 1 team home and 2 regular homes but for 5 you need plus or media

/auction [item]- makes auction show up on your screen

/order [item]- makes orders show up on your screen

/pay [person] [quantity] - allows you to give or pay someone

/settings - makes it so you can adjust settings

/tpa [person] - ask someone if you can tp to them

/tpahere [person] - ask someone if they can tp to you

/warp crates - tp to crates

/rtp - random teleport, choose between the Overworld, The Nether, or The End

/shop - shop shows up on your screen
